# KHAN Solutions

KHAN Solutions builds VETEK, an all-in-one veterinary practice management platform (SaaS) for single and multi-branch clinics. VETEK combines multi-branch inventory with batch tracking, a point of sale with tax snapshots, seven clinical record types, and real-time analytics in one multi-tenant platform.

## About VETEK

VETEK is veterinary practice management software for clinics with one or many branches. It runs in the browser and on mobile via a responsive PWA, with full interface and content support in English, Spanish, and Portuguese. Data for each clinic is fully isolated in a multi-tenant architecture, and clinical histories can be transferred between branches and clinics.

## Key Facts

- Product: VETEK — veterinary practice management platform
- Company: KHAN Solutions, founded 2024, serving Latin America
- Pricing: Premium plan $30 USD/month per clinic — every module and branch included
- Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese (full i18n)
- Architecture: multi-tenant SaaS with isolated data per clinic
- Platform: web-based PWA, works on desktop, tablet, and mobile
- Rating: 4.8/5 based on 150 clinic user ratings
- Support: email support with response within 24 hours; implementation training available
- Trial: free evaluation period available for new clinics

## Features

- Multi-branch inventory: batch/lot tracking with manufacturing and expiration dates, auto-generated batch codes, inter-branch transfers, real-time stock levels, low-stock and expiry dashboard alarms
- Cash register (POS): per-branch, per-shift sessions, batch-level product selection, automatic inventory deduction on sale, tax-inclusive movement recording, instant closing difference calculation, surplus/shortage detection, full audit trail
- Clinical records: seven types (consultation, emergency, surgery, hospitalization, laboratory, vaccination, follow-up), SOAP format with anamnesis/diagnosis/treatment, emergency triage levels I–V, evidence file uploads, inter-clinic transfer of complete patient history
- Real-time dashboard: WebSocket live synchronization across all branches
- WhatsApp client verification
- Role-based access control (RBAC) with granular permissions
- Financial analytics: revenue, COGS, gross profit, margins, ROI, P&L with tax breakdowns
- Multi-country tax compliance with time-bound rates and historical snapshots for audits
- Security: encrypted authentication, AES-256 encryption, isolated tenant data, encrypted file storage
- PWA: installable, responsive design for mobile access

## Pricing

VETEK Premium — $30 USD/month per clinic. One plan covers every module, every branch, and every feature with no per-module fees or hidden costs. Request a demo for onboarding and data migration assistance.
